theme: Parley, tempting offer, secret and group choices
reuse: Parley has one inline precedent (ambassador_kehleyr.go) — lift it into ONE helper for Selvala, Storm Fleet Negotiator and Innocuous Researcher; Selvala's parley is a MANA ability with reveals and draws (docs 'Adding a mana ability' — watch item: confirm a mana ability may run a multi-player reveal; if not, stop and report); tempting offer: tempt_with_discovery.go, batch07_helpers.go; secret choices: game/secret_choice.go, a_killer_among_us.go ('Reveal the player you chose' cost — Stalking Leonin; each opponent secretly choosing — Prisoner's Dilemma, queue one secret choice per opponent); 'starting with the next opponent in turn order, each player chooses': rejoin_the_fight.go; 'can't cast spells until your next turn': game/cast_ban.go; Map token: MapToken; investigate: batch 31's helper.

cards.name: Selvala, Explorer Returned
cards.oracle_text: Parley — {T}: Each player reveals the top card of their library. For each nonland card revealed this way, add {G} and you gain 1 life. Then each player draws a card. (Activate only as an instant.)

cards.name: Storm Fleet Negotiator
cards.oracle_text:
Flying
Parley — Whenever this creature attacks, each player reveals the top card of their library. For each nonland card revealed this way, you create a Map token. Then each player draws a card. (A Map token is an artifact with "{1}, {T}, Sacrifice this token: Target creature you control explores. Activate only as a sorcery.")

related.name: Map
related.oracle_text: {1}, {T}, Sacrifice this artifact: Target creature you control explores. Activate only as a sorcery. (Reveal the top card of your library. Put that card into your hand if it's a land. Otherwise, put a +1/+1 counter on that creature, then put the card back or put it into your graveyard.)

cards.name: Innocuous Researcher
cards.oracle_text:
Parley — Whenever this creature attacks, each player reveals the top card of their library. For each nonland card revealed this way, you investigate. Then each player draws a card.
At the beginning of your end step, you may untap all lands you control. If you do, you can't cast spells until your next turn.

related.name: Clue
related.oracle_text: {2}, Sacrifice this token: Draw a card.

cards.name: Tempt with Vengeance
cards.oracle_text: Tempting offer — Create X 1/1 red Elemental creature tokens with haste. Each opponent may create X 1/1 red Elemental creature tokens with haste. For each opponent who does, create X 1/1 red Elemental creature tokens with haste.

cards.name: Tempt with Bunnies
cards.oracle_text: Tempting Offer — Draw a card and create a 1/1 white Rabbit creature token. Then each opponent may draw a card and create a 1/1 white Rabbit creature token. For each opponent who does, you draw a card and you create a 1/1 white Rabbit creature token.

cards.name: Sadistic Shell Game
cards.oracle_text: Starting with the next opponent in turn order, each player chooses a creature you don't control. Destroy the chosen creatures.

cards.name: Disorienting Choice
cards.oracle_text: For each opponent, choose up to one target artifact or enchantment that player controls. For each permanent chosen this way, its controller may exile it. Then if one or more of the chosen permanents are still on the battlefield, you search your library for up to that many land cards, put them onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.

cards.name: Intellectual Offering
cards.oracle_text:
Choose an opponent. You and that player each draw three cards.
Choose an opponent. Untap all nonland permanents you control and all nonland permanents that player controls.

cards.name: Stalking Leonin
cards.oracle_text:
When this creature enters, secretly choose an opponent.
Reveal the player you chose: Exile target creature that's attacking you if it's controlled by the chosen player. Activate only once.

cards.name: Prisoner's Dilemma
cards.oracle_text:
Each opponent secretly chooses silence or snitch, then the choices are revealed. If each opponent chose silence, Prisoner's Dilemma deals 4 damage to each of them. If each opponent chose snitch, Prisoner's Dilemma deals 8 damage to each of them. Otherwise, Prisoner's Dilemma deals 12 damage to each opponent who chose silence.
Flashback {5}{R}{R}
